description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a Text-To-Speech (TTS) system, including a TTSSpeaker class managing speech synthesis pipeline and a TTSSpeakerClient interface for callback handling.

classes.name: TTSSpeakerClient
classes.description: Interface for callback notifications during TTS playback events.

classes.name: SpeechData
classes.description: Data structure representing speech information, including client callback, speech ID, callsign, text, security, and volume.

classes.name: TTSSpeaker
classes.description: Core class managing speech synthesis, pipeline, and queueing functionalities.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::ensurePipeline
methods.description: Ensures that the TTS pipeline is properly set up.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::speak
methods.description: Starts speaking a given text with specified parameters.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if a particular speech ID is currently speaking.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::getSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific speech.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::cancelSpeech
methods.description: Cancels speech output, optionally by ID.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::reset
methods.description: Resets the speaker to initial state.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::getPipelineType
methods.description: Returns the current type of the pipeline (MP3 or PCM).
